## Title

THE PADLOCK MYTH

## Caption (Instagram)

```
HTTPS seals the connection and a certificate tells your browser which domain it reached. A scam site can have both. The padlock is a protected connection, not an honest business - check the site, not just the lock.
```

## YouTube Shorts

**Title:** HTTP vs HTTPS

**Description:**

```
HTTPS seals the connection and a certificate tells your browser which domain it reached. A scam site can have both. The padlock is a protected connection, not an honest business - check the site, not just the lock.

Sources:
- HTTP is a client-server protocol for exchanging messages between a browser and a website. (Overview of HTTP (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/Overview checked 2026-10-31
- HTTPS is HTTP encrypted with TLS between client and server. (HTTPS (MDN Glossary)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/HTTPS checked 2026-10-31
- Plain HTTP is readable to anyone who can watch the network; encrypted traffic is not. (What is HTTPS? (Cloudflare Learning Center)) https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ssl/what-is-https/ checked 2026-10-31
- A certificate is what verifies that a provider is who it says it is, and it names the domain. (What is HTTPS? (Cloudflare Learning Center)) https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ssl/what-is-https/ checked 2026-10-31
- HTTPS is cheap and available to any site, including a scam site, so the lock is not a reputation. (What is HTTPS? (Cloudflare Learning Center)) https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ssl/what-is-https/ checked 2026-10-31
- The padlock marks an encrypted connection; it is not a statement about the business behind it. (What is HTTPS? (Cloudflare Learning Center)) https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ssl/what-is-https/ checked 2026-10-31
- An encrypted connection and an honest website are separate claims. (HTTPS (MDN Glossary)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/HTTPS checked 2026-10-31
```
